programmes.d: Tony is distraught when it appears that his friend may be targeted for revenge by a dangerous escaped convict.
A rock musician helps Hunter search for the assailant of a pregnant woman being kept alive artificially until doctors can deliver the child, which Sergeant McCall decides to adopt.
McCall fears that Hunter's temper will outweigh his judgment when his former girlfriend is murdered and Hunter thinks he knows the identity of the killer.
While investigating a murder, McCall is shot and paralyzed after learning about a prostitution ring operating along the highway in a fleet of motor homes.
With Elrose Fashions in its death throes, David and Eli's tenuous relationship shatters, and David seeks to avenge his grievous losses against Rick Pinzolo.
David Sternberg's final act is to leave a letter incriminating Rick Pinzolo in a murder he witnessed, and Raglin desperately seeks to make the charges stick.
When Frank learns his wife is going to die, Vinnie uses some missing O.C.B. funds to enable her to get a lifesaving transplant.
Rachel goes into labor while Tony is out on a ledge trying to stop a troubled cop from jumping.
Rachel witnesses a robbery-murder, but “reasonable doubt” releases the suspect she positively IDs.
A rape victim takes matters into her own hands when diplomatic immunity shields her attacker. Meanwhile, Tony's new baby is giving him many sleepless nights.
